name: Goodnight

timeline.event: Construction on Building 1 and 2 looks about halfway to completion. Foundations and utility trenches are visible for Building 3-4. Building 5-6 have an outline. The substation appears to be expanding.
Progress is made on all buildings, Building 1 and 2 specically have begun to install cooling structures. The substation expansion seems to be nearing completion.

Building 2 operational. The completion date for Building 2 Tenant Improvement is 2026-11-07, about 2 months later than Building 1. We therefore add 2 months to the Building 1 operational date.
